INTRODUCTION_TO_THE_FACULTY_OF_INFORMATI: INTRODUCTION TO THE FACULTY OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
CONTENT1FACULTY_OF_INFORMATION_TECHNOLOG: The Faculty of Information Technology, formerly the Department of Information Technology, was established in 2004 within the School of Technology, National Economics University. For over 20 years, the Faculty has focused on specialized training, providing the labor market with thousands of highly qualified graduates in Information Technology and Computer Science. These graduates possess strong professional skills and work abilities that meet the needs of society. The Faculty also regularly conducts scientific research, collaborating with domestic and international organizations on projects and research topics.
CONTENT2FACULTY_OF_INFORMATION_TECHNOLOG: With the advantage of training in Technology at one of Vietnam's most modern universities, a leading center for training and research in economics, management, and business administration, the training program combines technical knowledge with rich economic and business knowledge. Students at the Faculty believe they have the opportunity to equip themselves with additional knowledge and skills in economics and management beyond their professional skills, which will be a strong advantage when they graduate and enter the workforce.
TRAIN_PROGRAM_CONTENT: The Faculty of Information Technology at NEU offers high-quality, flexible training programs that are regularly updated to reflect the latest industry trends. The faculty's main fields of study include:
Graphic_design_content: Comprehensive training in applied arts, 2D/3D design, brand identity development, multimedia design, and the application of technology in visual creation.
Information_technology_content: Comprehensive training in software development, system administration, and IT applications in businesses.
ACHIEVEMENTS_AND_CONTRIBUTIONS_CONTENT: Throughout its development, the Faculty has trained thousands of high-quality IT graduates who are currently working and succeeding in various fields at domestic and international businesses. In addition, the Faculty of Information Technology also collaborates with major enterprises such as VNPT and VIETTEL to promote research, receive funding, and develop projects with high practical value.

Computer_Science1: Computer science is the study of how computers work, how they process, store, and transmit information, artificial intelligence, security, computer networks, and how humans can control or interact with computers to solve real-world problems. Studying this field will equip you with the ability to master all stages of program development, software development, and information system development to address real-world issues.
What_do_you_study_in_computer_science: 1. What do you study in computer science?

Computer_Science3: - Fundamental knowledge areas: Foundational mathematics, Basic and advanced programming, Data structures & algorithms, Computer architecture & operating systems, Databases, Computer networks, Programming languages.
Computer_Science4: - Specialized knowledge areas: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Information Security/Cybersecurity, Blockchain/Cryptography, Software Development, Web/Mobile Development, Systems Programming/Embedded Programming/IoT (Internet of Things).

Facilities2: Viet - Hung Industrial University was established and has been operating since November 25, 1977, with a 48-year tradition of training. As a public university under the Ministry of Industry and Trade, the university is honored to bear the names of two countries: VIETNAM - HUNGARY. The university has gone through stages of development alongside the country's development and continues to exist, develop, rise, and adapt to all changes in the world in general and the country in particular.
Facilities3: When choosing a learning environment, everyone certainly has their own goals and desires. In any learning environment, we will find love and attachment to it. If you choose to study at Viet - Hung Industrial University, you will have many feelings about the learning environment here. Specifically:
Facilities5: Viet - Hung Industrial University has 3 training locations:
Facilities6: * Tung Thien Campus (formerly Son Tay): No. 16, Huu Nghi Street, Tung Thien Ward, Hanoi (Mr. Quan 0984 430 936)
Facilities7: * Tay Phuong Campus (formerly Thach That): No. 88, Road 419 - Tay Phuong, Hanoi (Km 19 - Direction from My Dinh to Thang Long Avenue - Ms. Quyen 0984 239 125)
Facilities8: * Thanh Xuan Campus: 6th Floor, HaNoi Center Point - 27 Le Van Luong, Thanh Xuan Ward, Hanoi (Intersection with Hoang Dao Thuy street - Mr. Thang 0985 600 964)
Facilities9: These three training locations are all located in Hanoi city with the distance between campuses not too far from each other (each campus is about 10 - 15 km apart), giving you many opportunities to choose your desired study location. If you like a bustling and lively environment, you can choose Le Van Luong campus and Cong Thuong campus located in the center of Hanoi city; if you prefer a fresh and airy environment, choose Son Tay campus; while Thach That campus in the middle of the two brings an interesting half-urban, half-rural environment. Thus, the training campuses meet all the aspirations of students.
Facilities11: * TUNG THIEN Campus: No. 16, Huu Nghi Street, Tung Thien Ward, Hanoi City
Facilities12: * TAY PHUONG Campus: No. 88, Road 419 - Tay Phuong, Hanoi City
Facilities13: * THANH XUAN Campus: 6th Floor - HaNoi Center Point, No. 27 Le Van Luong, Thanh Xuan Ward, Hanoi City
Facilities14: Regarding training activities: the university offers 13 majors:
Facilities15: * Economics - Management group: Banking and Finance; Business Administration; Economics; Digital Economy; Financial Technology; Marketing.
Facilities16: * Technology - Engineering Technology group: Information Technology; Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technology; Mechanical Engineering Technology; Construction Engineering Technology; Automotive Engineering Technology; Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering Technology; Computer Science. Viet Hung Industrial University is a public university under the Ministry of Industry and Trade, all training activities comply with the regulations of the Ministry of Education and Training to meet the needs of learners and the recruitment needs of society.
Facilities17: Regarding the staff and lecturers: Viet-Hung Industrial University has a team of enthusiastic teaching staff who always care about their students through homeroom teachers, academic advisors, subject teachers, specialized faculties, and functional departments to resolve students' arising issues promptly. When students have issues requiring advice and support, the team of teachers and school staff will participate in advising and helping students solve problems.
Facilities18: Regarding the spiritual life of students: during their studies, students can participate in extracurricular activities organized by the university or locality to enrich their spiritual life and understanding. For students at Thanh Xuan campus, they can conveniently participate in welcoming national events and visit the capital with many interesting places. For students at Son Tay campus, they can visit eco-tourism areas, getting closer to nature such as Ao Vua, Khoang Xanh, Thien Son Suoi Nga, Duong Lam ancient village, Son Tay ancient citadel... As for students at Thach That campus, located between Son Tay and Le Van Luong campuses, they can flexibly travel to the 2 campuses above to participate in cultural and spiritual activities according to their preferences. Besides, the university also has clubs for students to interact and learn such as Guitar, Book, Football, Modern Dance, Martial Arts clubs...
Facilities19: Regarding the environment for finding part-time jobs for students during their studies: the university always supports students who need to find part-time jobs during their studies and after graduation. Among the three training campuses, Le Van Luong campus is in the city center, so there are relatively many part-time jobs for students to explore and choose from. At Son Tay and Thach That campuses, if students cannot find a part-time job themselves, they can completely go to the student support and startup center to be introduced and advised by teachers on jobs around the study area, helping students earn extra income and experience. In particular, the university always updates job information for students, especially graduates, to provide them with many job opportunities suitable for their field of study after graduation.
Facilities20: With a learning environment that has all the above elements, students can choose a suitable study location at Viet - Hung Industrial University, helping them acquire full knowledge, skills, and qualifications to enter the real world with solid baggage in hand. You can find out more information about the university on the websites: viu.edu.vn, tuyensinh.viu.edu, facebook.com/dhcnvh...
